## What's new

- Check for official Ginkgo updates under **Settings → Tools → Check for updates**. See what changed before choosing to download.
- Ginkgo verifies the downloaded APK and hands it to Android’s system installer for confirmation. There are no background checks or forced updates.

This is the first release with the built-in updater. If you’re using 0.4.58 or earlier, download the APK from this release once to enable future in-app updates.
